domain_description: Voice synthesis, emotion recognition, speech-to-text, conversation management, personality-driven dialogue, multi-language support, voice cloning, and audio processing for AI-powered voice interaction systems. Covers real-time streaming, prosody control, speaker diarization, and acoustic feature extraction.

engines.name: Voice Synthesis Engine
engines.function: Generate high-quality synthetic speech from text using neural TTS models with prosody control, emotion injection, SSML support, and real-time streaming capabilities via ElevenLabs, Cartesia, and local XTTS models.
doctrine_topics: neural TTS architecture and model selection
SSML markup for prosody and emphasis control
emotion tag injection and affect modulation
audio format selection and bitrate optimization

golden_queries.question: Design a real-time TTS pipeline that supports emotion-tagged text with under 200ms first-byte latency, fallback across three providers, and SSML prosody control
Compare the quality, latency, and cost tradeoffs between ElevenLabs v2, Cartesia Sonic, and local XTTS for a production voice assistant serving 10,000 concurrent users

engines.name: Emotion Recognition Engine
engines.function: Detect and classify emotions from speech audio using acoustic feature extraction, prosody analysis, and deep learning models for sentiment-aware voice interaction.
doctrine_topics: acoustic feature extraction (MFCC, pitch, energy, formants)
cultural and linguistic variation in emotional expression

golden_queries.question: Design an emotion recognition pipeline for a customer service voice bot that classifies caller emotion in real-time and adjusts response tone accordingly

engines.name: Speech-to-Text Engine
engines.function: Transcribe speech audio to text using ASR models with support for speaker diarization, punctuation restoration, domain vocabulary, and real-time streaming transcription.
doctrine_topics: domain-specific vocabulary and language model adaptation
word error rate (WER) optimization and benchmarking
voice activity detection (VAD) and endpoint detection
ASR confidence scoring and uncertainty handling

golden_queries.question: Architect a real-time speech-to-text system for transcribing multi-speaker oilfield radio communications with heavy background noise and domain-specific terminology

engines.name: Conversation Management Engine
engines.function: Manage multi-turn voice conversations with context tracking, turn-taking protocols, interruption handling, topic management, and dialogue state tracking for natural voice interfaces.
doctrine_topics: conversation flow design and fallback paths

golden_queries.question: Design a conversation management system for a voice assistant that maintains context across 20+ turns, handles interruptions gracefully, and routes to specialized knowledge domains based on topic detection

engines.name: Personality Engine
engines.function: Generate personality-consistent dialogue responses using character dossiers, speaking style profiles, emotional state machines, and catchphrase injection for AI voice personas.
doctrine_topics: personality dossier schema and trait modeling
speaking style transfer and consistency enforcement
emotional state machine design for character affect
character voice parameter mapping (pitch, rate, style)
personality consistency scoring and drift detection

golden_queries.question: Design a personality system for 6 distinct AI characters (Bree, Echo, GS343, Prometheus, Phoenix, Commander) that maintains consistent speaking styles, emotional responses, and catchphrases across thousands of interactions

engines.name: Multi-Language Engine
engines.function: Support real-time multi-language voice interaction including translation, language detection, code-switching, and culturally-adapted responses across 40+ languages.
doctrine_topics: language detection from audio and text signals
localization and internationalization (i18n) of voice interfaces

golden_queries.question: Design a voice interface that handles a bilingual English-Spanish conversation where the user code-switches mid-sentence, with real-time translation and culturally appropriate responses

engines.name: Voice Cloning Engine
engines.function: Clone and reproduce human voices from reference audio samples using speaker embedding extraction, fine-tuning, and real-time voice conversion while addressing ethical and legal compliance.
doctrine_topics: few-shot voice cloning from minimal samples
voice cloning model fine-tuning and adaptation
voice cloning quality metrics and evaluation
ethical and legal frameworks for voice cloning

golden_queries.question: Design a voice cloning pipeline that can produce a high-quality clone from 30 seconds of reference audio, with real-time inference under 300ms, and built-in audio watermarking for deepfake prevention

engines.name: Audio Processing Engine
engines.function: Process and enhance audio signals including noise reduction, echo cancellation, gain normalization, format conversion, spectral analysis, and audio fingerprinting for voice pipeline optimization.
doctrine_topics: noise reduction and speech enhancement algorithms
automatic gain control (AGC) and loudness normalization
audio format conversion and codec selection
spectral analysis and frequency domain processing
spatial audio and beamforming for microphone arrays
audio quality monitoring and degradation detection

golden_queries.question: Design an audio preprocessing pipeline for a voice assistant deployed in a noisy industrial environment (85+ dB ambient) that achieves intelligible speech recognition with under 50ms processing latency
